description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for grids/cartesian_uniform_2d/rules/varcoeff_laplacian_x_dirichlet_bc (conservative finite-volume variable-coefficient Laplacian div(k grad u), arithmetic-mean x-faces) driven by problems/heat_2d_varcoeff_x_dirichlet.esm. The problem is loaded once per resolution with the loader-API metaparameter binding (esm-spec 9.7.6 binding site 4) — NX is the open metaparameter (NY is edge-closed at 8; the solution is constant in the passive y axis and no y-operator appears), and the problem's spacing observeds and inlined coordinates use the NX name so the geometry follows each rebinding automatically. The manufactured solution with its closed-form MMS forcing makes u exact for the continuous variable-coefficient PDE (derivation in the problem file); the recorded relative-L2 and Linf errors at t=0.1 are pure spatial-discretization error, expected to fall as O(dx^2). Identical per-resolution to the 1-D sibling heat_1d_varcoeff_dirichlet because u/k are replicated across the passive axis.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
